(2017), 'Building an Argument Search Engine for the Web', Proceedings of the 4th Workshop on Argument Mining, pp. 49-59. Mirror used: https://huggingface.co/datasets/webis/args_me. Arguments originate from idebate.org and debatewise.org.
notes: Builder stance-1. Label = the premise's structured stance field (PRO/CON) towards the record's conclusion; the dataset's loading script args_me.py was not downloaded or run. Topic = conclusion, argument = premise text, cleaned and cut to whole sentences within 700 characters; portals ['debatewise.org', 'idebate.org']; filters in tools/records/build_stance.py. Group key (source_id) = normalised conclusion; the split is the hash of the component joining topics that share a discussion title or an argument prefix.
